title: A Giant Sleeping Baby Lies Alone in China's Gobi — Silk Road EP5 | China Travel Expert
description:
Drive far enough west along the old Silk Road, out past Dunhuang, and the empty Gobi hands you one of China's strangest sights: a giant infant, curled up asleep on the bare gravel.

It's called "Son of the Earth" (大地之子), a sculpture by Tsinghua University artist Dong Shubing, finished in 2016. Carved from red sandstone — 3D-scanned, cut block by block, then assembled on site — it stretches about 15 meters long and 4.3 meters high, lying prone in a peaceful sleep on the Gobi near Guazhou, in Gansu's Jiuquan region. The artist meant it as an image of humans and nature resting together. Out here, with nothing around for miles, it stops every traveler cold.

🧭 Expert Tip: It sits near Guazhou, Gansu — an easy add-on to a Dunhuang / Mogao Caves trip along the Hexi Corridor.
